release_notes:
V19.3 Updates:

- In-App Self-Updating: Automated installer packaging and silent background update execution with progress dialog.
- Bill Calculator Modern Date Range Picker: Added modern Month and Year dropdown selectors and fast step navigation for Pro-Rata billing.
- Standardized Date Format: Pro-Rata dates now default to and strictly format as DD.MM.YYYY.
- WBERC Subsidy Rule Enforcement: Domestic government relief correctly caps strictly at <= 300 units/month (or proportional pro-rata/quarterly limit).
- Fast Image Indexing Fix: Network and additional folders dynamically reloaded without stale cache, preserving ultra-fast raw slicing for 1M+ images.
- Bundled Application Suite: Includes both SpotImageViewerV19.3.exe and imagecheckgui.exe with Windows Setup installer.

previous_versions.release_notes:
V19.2 Updates:

- Integrated WBSedcl Meter Verification tool (Image Check GUI) directly into the main app Tools menu.
- Configured multi-executable compilation workflow to bundle both Spot Image Viewer and the Image Check GUI tool.
- Upgraded application suite release to V19.2.

V19.1 Updates:

- Added full Consumer Data workflow with fields: Consumer ID, Meter No, Name, Address, Mobile Number, Contractual Load, and Class.
- Added Name and Mobile search support with proper multi-result handling.
- Improved Details pane to show complete consumer information in compact wrapped format.
- Added Update Consumer Data action dialog with two options: Generate Template and Import Consumer Data.
- Added consumer data template generator (.xlsx) with required headers for easy copy/paste workflows.
- Search controls UI refined for alignment, spacing consistency, and better button behavior when consumer data is unavailable.
- Meter/Name/Mobile search controls are now disabled until consumer data is imported, with clear inline guidance.

V18.4 Updates:

- Image Viewer: Scroll mouse wheel to zoom in/out on images.
- Image Viewer: Click and drag to pan/move around when zoomed in.
- Theft Calculator: UI redesigned to match a consistent table-aligned layout.
- Bug fixes and visual improvements.

V18.3 Updates:

- Theft Calculator now supports decimal Hours/Day input.
- Added exact interpreted time display beside hour inputs (HH hr MM min).
- Improved hours editing behavior to avoid auto-overwrite while typing.
- Enforced valid Hours/Day range of 0 to 24 with normalization on focus-out.
- Improved update check dialog when no new version is found by showing version details and feature notes.

V18.2 Updates:

- Added dark mode toggle in main search controls.
- Improved dark theme consistency across listboxes, canvases, menus, and notes/folders toggles.
- Fixed Tariff Category dropdown text clipping in Bill Calculator by expanding combobox sizing behavior.

V18.1 Updates:

- Tariff Manager now supports adding and deleting tariff classes directly from the editor.
- Updated tariff structure includes Commercial Rate A(CM-II) and revised ED slabs.
- Theft fixed-demand calculation updated: load floor of 1 KVA, actual load for >= 1 KVA, and month roundup for fixed demand.
- One-time tariff migration marker added to reset old tariff JSON once for this release and preserve edits afterward.
